report: A, B, and C have agreed on a plan for the leaking espresso machine. B (for whom the machine has sentimental value) will make one short phone call for a repair quote and share it with A and C. A will then review the quote and settle a cost cap and deadline with B in one brief exchange; C will circulate the agreed limits to everyone. No repair work starts until the limits are agreed, and if the fix would exceed either limit, the machine is replaced with a simple low-maintenance one, which addresses A's wish for something easy to maintain. Remaining steps are with B: the call, the quote, and settling the limits with A. Everyone confirmed the arrangement, so the outstanding items are practical, not points of disagreement.
